# We'll iterate over all songs, but skip the first one (already added)

    # Parse title and artists
    if " by " in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(" by ", 1)
    else:
        # fallback: assume whole line is title
        title_part = line
        artists_part = ""
    
    # Search for the song
    search_res = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=line, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
    
    # Find exact match: title matches and artists match
    matched_song = None
    for song in search_res:
        if song['title'].lower() == title_part.strip().lower():
            # Check artists
            song_artists = {artist['name'].lower() for artist in song['artists']}
            expected_artists = {a.strip().lower() for a in artists_part.split(',')} if artists_part else set()
            if song_artists == expected_artists:
                matched_song = song
                break
    
    if matched_song:
        song_id = matched_song['song_id']
        print(f"Matched: {line} -> song_id {song_id}")
        # Add to playlist
        add_res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=654, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
        print(f"  Add result: {add_res}")
    else:
        print(f"NO MATCH for: {line}")
